research_scope: Canonical skills index integrity and Awoken transformation count reconciliation.
rules: skills-index.json must contain exactly the same canonical record keys and order as skills.json.
Transformation count means canonical Awoken parent records and must equal 15.
The five stage-only forms remain documented through their parent records and are not duplicated as canonical records.
No legacy target count of 18 is promoted into generated canonical metadata.

verification_audit.duplicate_check: canonical key comparison implemented in scripts/validate_skills.py
verification_audit.index_check: full record key/order/summary-field comparison implemented in scripts/validate_skills.py
verification_audit.awoken_check: 15-parent requirement implemented in scripts/validate_skills.py and scripts/validate_awoken_model.py
